 ('keeps the exact channel subscribed through refused close and releases only that channel after retry','        const returned: number[] = [];',['        const { default: rendererModule } = await import("../../../🧬️schema/🔣️.json");\n','        const schema = { $ref: `${rendererModule.$id}#/$defs/PluginRuntimeChannelCloseV1` };\n','        const { default: Ajv } = await import("ajv");\n','        expect(new Ajv({ strict: true }).addSchema(rendererModule).compile(schema)(fixture)).toBe(true);\n']),

 ('composes the production plugin runtime with one real UI owner through exact patch ACK and retirement','        const previous = {',['        const { default: Ajv } = await import("ajv");\n','        const { default: rendererModule } = await import("../../../🧬️schema/🔣️.json");\n','        expect(new Ajv({ strict: true }).addSchema(rendererModule).compile({ $ref: `${rendererModule.$id}#/$defs/PluginRuntimeLifecycleSchedulerV1` })(fixture)).toBe(true);\n']),
 ('retries actual actor retirement with the original witness after final acknowledgement failure','        for (const row of fixture.disposal.retirementRetry) {',['        const { default: schema } = await import("../../../🧬️schema/🔣️.json");\n','        const { default: Ajv } = await import("ajv");\n','        expect(new Ajv({ strict: true }).addSchema(schema).getSchema(`${schema.$id}#/$defs/ActorDocumentPortFixtureV1`)!(fixture)).toBe(true);\n'])]

 token='      it("'+name+'", async () => {';assert text.count(token)==1;start=text.index(token);end=text.index(first,start);assert end-start<2000;head=text[start:end]
 for line in lines:assert head.count(line)==1,line;head=head.replace(line,'')
 text=text[:start]+head+text[end:]
assert p.read_bytes()==before;p.write_text(text);actions.append(dict(path=str(p.relative_to(r)),action='updated',beforeSha256=hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),afterSha256=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),exclusive=False,scope='Four original worker behavior law heads retire only whole-trial validation/imports'))

text=text.replace(old,new);assert p.read_bytes()==before;p.write_text(text);actions.append(dict(path=str(p.relative_to(r)),action='updated',beforeSha256=hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),afterSha256=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),exclusive=False,scope='Meaningless Schema-with-only-defs whole fixture admission replaced by genuine per-command and receipt Ajv'))
(t/'📥️root-renderer-trial-actions.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(actions=actions,wholeFileExclusivityClaim=False),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print('Three whole trials and four admissions retired; genuine actor owner binding commands receipts and behavioral laws retained')
